prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Gstreamer latency calculation
I have a gstreamer pipeline on python that receives a udp stream as an input and a udp stream as an output. When I visualize the input stream and the output stream I can see a delay. Can you please provide a tool that calculates the delay?
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Ceramic tile defect detection
client: Halvorsen Ceramics
client_industry: manufacturing
start: 2022-05
end: 2022-08
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Python
- PyTorch

  PC beside the kiln line.
metrics:

- false rejects from 8% to 2.1%

Style:
- Open by briefly introducing yourself.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Ceramic tile defect detection (p07).
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning engineer with 6 years of experience in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning.

I built a camera-based crack and chip detector for Halvorsen Ceramics, exported to ONNX and running on an industrial PC beside the kiln line. It achieved 97.4% recall on cracks and reduced false rejects from 8% to 2.1%.

For your Gstreamer pipeline, I can build a Python tool to measure end-to-end delay between the incoming UDP stream and outgoing UDP stream so you can visualize and quantify the latency clearly.

Would you like the tool to calculate latency from timestamps embedded in the stream, or should it infer delay by comparing the input and output pipelines directly?
